parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom structural part of the storage cabinet, made of MDF for stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides foundational support for the entire cabinet, ensuring balance and weight distribution.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel that allows access to the interior storage space, made of MDF with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It opens and closes to provide access to the shelves and stored items inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main body structure of the cabinet, made of MDF panels joined together.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the door and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: The top shelf is an internal horizontal panel made of MDF, used for storing items inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: The middle shelf is an internal horizontal panel made of MDF, positioned between the top and bottom shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space and helps organize items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: The bottom shelf is the lowest internal horizontal panel made of MDF, supporting heavier stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable surface for heavier or larger items stored at the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
